verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege credentials are a fair question for a hosted model API platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack never documents per-key scopes, permissions, or restricted keys. The `user_id` parameter (deepseek-docs-5/14) only lets you manage end users under one account; it does not restrict what a credential can do. The "Rate Limit & Isolation" page covers concurrency limits, not credential privileges.
